description.p: Discover, install and update desktop applications from Flathub. Browse featured applications and categories, search the catalog, and inspect screenshots, permissions and release information.

Store reads user and system Flatpak installations. User installations can be managed directly; system repositories remain host-managed. On enzimOS, the permission service reviews installation requests when available. Other desktops use Flatpak directly.
Flatpak is required for repository and installation operations. Catalog metadata and artwork need network access; previously cached information remains available offline.
